belief_updates.remaining_alternatives: Message semantics remain bundled with wording, salience, token length, event packaging, completeness cues, and provider-side variability. Exact request bodies and reported fingerprints do not guarantee identical hidden serving state.
belief_updates.statement: For these 24 fixed M4 contexts, the frozen B5 request variants yield finite label changes, but no directional or causal message-semantic effect is identified.
belief_updates.what_changed: Independent replay verified every assigned request and showed identical historical/current request bytes with label disagreement on many fixed cases, adding finite output non-repeatability as a concrete alternative to single-call view attribution.

denominator_summary: A1: 24 fixed contexts, 72 requests. A2: 40 fixed rows in 20 groups, 160 requests. Campaign: 232 assigned, 232 attempted, 232 valid HTTP 200 tool responses, 0 retries, 0 replacements, 0 unattempted. All assigned rows remain in primary denominators.

material_update.remaining_alternatives: The comparison cannot prove identical hidden provider state, immutable weights, or the cause of response differences; it does not remove the A1 wording, salience, token-length, and event-package confounds.
material_update.what_changed: A post-hoc same-case audit established that exact historical/current request bodies and reported fingerprints matched for 48 observations, yet labels matched only 7/24 Public-only and 22/24 Privileged-original cases. This is concrete finite non-repeatability and weakens attribution from one call per view.

next_action: Continue offline only. outcome_rationale: The 232 assigned requests and all frozen evidence replayed successfully, but the preregistered directional A1 pattern was not met and a repeated exact request profile varied. A post-hoc historical comparison found identical request bodies and reported fingerprints but different outputs on fixed cases. A1 changes multiple input features, so these observations do not identify a message-semantic or causal effect.
results_summary: A1: 12/24 Public-only→Neutral, 20/24 Neutral→Original, and 19/24 Public-only→Original labels changed. The unstable duplicated profile triggers DUPLICATE-SENSITIVE / INCONCLUSIVE. Post-hoc identical-body/fingerprint historical matches had label agreement 7/24 Public and 22/24 Privileged-original; exact full contrast transitions recurred in 7/24 cases. A2: arithmetic aid 39/40 exact on a mechanically computable target; bundled prompt+enum order reversal changed 36/40. No collusion or intent label is inferred.
review_finding: An isolated critic reviewed the sanitized outputs and the post-hoc exact-request comparison. It agrees that the finite exact-request disagreements weaken causal attribution but do not identify their cause. This is a scientific desk review, not a second raw-byte replay. The separate auditor reports PASS_INDEPENDENT_RAW_REPLAY.
scientific_update: This fixed-corpus audit shows finite response sensitivity and finite non-repeatability for exact request observations under matching provider-reported fingerprints. It does not identify why outputs vary, prove identical hidden provider state, establish semantic comprehension, or demonstrate collusion. The primary scientific result remains inconclusive.
